protocol.selection: training SSE only, reselected inside every CV fold
protocol.metric_weighting: equal checkpoint weight; macro equals capability mean
protocol.parameter_count: continuous coefficients; discrete search counted separately

part_b_accounting.shared: 3 capability offsets + q shared shape slopes
part_b_accounting.per_capability: 1 common offset + q+2 selected capability slopes

subsets.E-only: all three capability E slopes (1 choice)
subsets.T+E: one capability gets T and E; others one each (12 choices)
subsets.F2: each capability gets one of s,z*s and one of e,z*e (64 choices)

part_b_accounting.limitation: reduced nonnested models; equal coefficient count, unequal discrete search budget
part_b_accounting.threshold: shared MAE minus per-capability MAE > 0.02 nats; descriptive
